recommendation: Keep the source fix. Future work should start from current Composition.section.text and document-presentation rules; regenerate the checked-in Composition SVG through the normal build pipeline if generated tooltips are refreshed.
issue_request: FHIR-5153 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Composition issue asking to resolve narrative-only section handling by constraining old section content from Reference(Any) to List, updating List.text for use as section narrative, and using an appropriate emptyReason when section content was naturally narrative-only.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git-svn commit 7b1600d410a98cdeb772f6c2ffeba7ed3b5a433f (#5151 + #5152 + #5153), which changed the old Composition.section.content spreadsheet entry to Reference(List), adjusted examples to go through List, and expanded List narrative notes.
additional_context: FHIR-7404 later superseded the old section.content/List model by moving narrative into Composition and replacing section.content with Composition.section.text and Composition.section.entry. Later issues and current source keep attested document narrative in Composition/section text, not List.text unless incorporated.
reconciliation: Edited source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml so Composition.section.entry and Composition.section.emptyReason refer to empty sections rather than empty Lists. No attempt was made to reintroduce the retired List-only section-content model.
source_changes: source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml: changed Composition.section.entry and Composition.section.emptyReason wording from stale List terminology to section terminology.
